d: In Siddipet's Bhupampally village, Telangana, a struggling tea-stall owner named Chakali Rajitha turned out to be a ruthless serial killer driven by sheer greed. Inspired by crime thrillers like 'Drishyam', Rajitha trained her 15-year-old minor son with gym gear and protein powder to assist in strangling victims and disposing of bodies. The duo targeted lone women, looted their gold ornaments, stuffed the bodies into travel bags, and set them ablaze. Watch this episode of 'Wanted' on Khabargaon as we uncover Commissioner S. Rashmi Perumal's investigation, critical CCTV breakthroughs, and…
